description: Reusable financial-value primitives for typed monetary amounts.

allowed_ir_sources: methodology-licensed amount literals such as USD 5 million
notes: Currency is a sort: the type of locally grounded currency entities such as USD, EUR, or another source-mentioned currency.
currency is a function: an accessor from a MonetaryAmount to its Currency.
MonetaryAmountValue carries the numeric value part of a stated amount.
MonetaryAmountScale is the type of locally grounded scale entities such as Million when the source uses scaled monetary wording.
Percent is the reusable value sort for source-grounded percentage quantities; concrete percentages such as 50% and 5% should remain formula literals.
This domain prelude should not be used to invent monetary facts not warranted by the source.
